items.title_cn: 降钙素原诊断感染性胰腺坏死：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: Procalcitonin for diagnosing infected pancreatic necrosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 感染性胰腺坏死（IPN）是急性胰腺炎（AP）最严重的局部并发症之一，在导致AP相关死亡中起核心作用。降钙素原（PCT）作为一种优先响应细菌感染的血清生物标志物，在理论上具有区分感染性坏死与无菌性坏死的潜力。然而，既往的系统评价受限于样本量小、亚组分析深度不足以及缺乏正式的证据分级。目前尚缺乏以IPN为临床终点、专门针对该问题进行更新的综合荟萃分析。目的 本荟萃分析的主要目的是评估PCT在AP患者中检测IPN的诊断效能。预测重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）作为次要分析进行评估，PCT指导抗生素治疗的相关证据作为探索性分析进行总结。方法 检索PubMed、Embase和Cochrane图书馆，纳入评估PCT用于诊断IPN（主要目标）、预测重症AP（SAP；次要分析）或指导AP患者抗生素使用的原始研究。通过双变量随机效应模型计算合并敏感性、特异性、似然比和诊断优势比，绘制层级汇总受试者工作特征（HSROC）曲线。预设亚组分析涵盖PCT截断值、采样时间、研究设计和参考标准。采用QUADAS-2进行偏倚评估；证据确定性采用GRADE-DTA框架进行评级。结果 共39项研究符合纳入标准：16项关于PCT诊断IPN（2，156例患者；512例IPN病例），20项关于PCT预测SAP（3，386例患者；934例SAP病例），3项关于PCT指导抗生素治疗的随机对照试验。在IPN诊断方面，合并敏感性为0.82（95% CI：0.75–0.87），合并特异性为0.84（95% CI：0.78–0.89），曲线下面积（AUC）为0.90（95% CI：0.87–0.92）；GRADE证据确定性为低。在SAP预测方面，合并敏感性为0.83，特异性为0.76，AUC为0.87；证据确定性为低。截断值为1.0–3.5 ng/mL时，敏感性与特异性之间达到最佳平衡（AUC 0.92）。连续动态监测（AUC 0.93）显著优于单次入院测量（AUC 0.85）。结论 PCT在识别IPN方面表现出良好的整体能力，可作为IPN风险分层的辅助生物标志物。1.0–3.5 ng/mL的截断值范围及连续监测可能有助于临床风险分层。这些与截断值相关的发现需要在前瞻性多中心研究中加以外部验证，研究应预设截断值，并采用整合临床、影像学、微生物学及操作证据的标准化判定参考标准，在临床实施引流或坏死组织清除术时纳入培养确认。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background Infected pancreatic necrosis (IPN) ranks among the most severe local complications of acute pancreatitis (AP) and plays a central role in driving AP-related death. Procalcitonin (PCT), a serum biomarker that responds preferentially to bacterial infection, has theoretical promise for differentiating infected from sterile necrosis. Earlier systematic reviews, though, are limited by small sample sizes, shallow subgroup analysis, and a lack of formal evidence grading. An updated synthesis that focuses specifically on IPN as the clinical endpoint is missing. Aim This meta-analysis primarily aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of PCT for detecting IPN in patients with AP. Prediction of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) was assessed as a secondary analysis, and evidence on PCT-guided antibiotic therapy was summarized as an exploratory analysis. Methods PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched for original studies that assessed PCT for diagnosing IPN (primary objective), predicting severe AP (SAP; secondary analysis), or guiding antibiotic use in AP patients. Pooled sensitivity, specificity, likelihood ratios, and diagnostic odds ratios were calculated through a bivariate random-effects model. Hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves were plotted. Pre-specified subgroup analyses covered PCT cutoff value, sampling time, study design, and reference standard. QUADAS-2 was used for bias assessment; evidence certainty was rated with the GRADE-DTA framework. Results Thirty-nine studies met inclusion criteria: 16 on PCT for IPN diagnosis (2,156 patients; 512 IPN cases), 20 on PCT for SAP prediction (3,386 patients; 934 SAP cases), and 3 randomized controlled trials on PCT-guided antibiotic therapy. For IPN diagnosis, pooled sensitivity was 0.82 (95% CI: 0.75–0.87), pooled specificity 0.84 (95% CI: 0.78–0.89), and area under the curve (AUC) 0.90 (95% CI: 0.87–0.92); GRADE certainty was low. For SAP prediction, pooled sensitivity was 0.83, specificity 0.76, AUC 0.87; evidence certainty was low. A cutoff of 1.0-3.5 ng/mL gave the best trade-off between sensitivity and specificity (AUC 0.92). Serial dynamic monitoring (AUC 0.93) outperformed single admission measurement (AUC 0.85) by a wide margin. Conclusions PCT shows good overall ability to identify IPN and may be incorporated as an adjunctive biomarker for IPN risk stratification. A cutoff range of 1.0–3.5 ng/mL and serial monitoring may help clinical risk stratification. These cutoff-related findings require external validation in prospective multicenter studies with pre-specified cutoffs and standardized adjudicated reference criteria integrating clinical, radiologic, microbiologic, and procedural evidence, with culture confirmation incorporated when drainage or necrosectomy is clinically performed.
items.summary_cn: 该meta分析显示降钙素原诊断感染性胰腺坏死的合并敏感度为0.82、特异度为0.84、AUC为0.90，且1.0-3.5 ng/mL的截断值及动态监测（AUC 0.93）优于单次入院测量（AUC 0.85），提示其可作为IPN风险分层的辅助生物标志物。

items.title_cn: 重症胰腺炎中的翡翠色渗出液：急性腹膜透析作为双重作用支持？
items.title_en: Emerald effluent in severe pancreatitis: Acute PD as dual-action support?
items.abstract_cn: 一名50岁男性患者，因疑似重症胆石性胰腺炎、多器官功能衰竭及少尿期3期急性肾损伤，接受了床旁急性腹膜透析（PD），以在血流动力学可耐受的情况下提供肾脏支持并进行腹腔灌洗。置管后引流出大量腹水，且迅速变为鲜亮的翠绿色。培养结果始终为无菌生长，而流出液中的淀粉酶（11,041 U/L）和脂肪酶（50,750 U/L）显著升高，提示为炎症性胰腺渗漏，而非感染性腹膜炎或胆道穿孔。在腹膜透析过程中，流出液中的酶浓度和细胞计数逐渐下降，酸中毒得到纠正，肾功能有所改善。患者最终因感染性休克死亡。翠绿色腹膜透析流出液较为罕见，需紧急评估是否存在严重的腹腔内病变。
items.abstract_en: A 50-year-old man with severe presumed gallstone pancreatitis, multiorgan failure, and oliguric stage 3 acute kidney injury underwent bedside acute peritoneal dialysis (PD) for haemodynamically tolerated kidney support and intra peritoneal lavage. Catheter insertion drained a large volume of ascites that rapidly became vivid emerald green. Cultures remained sterile, whereas effluent amylase (11,041 U/L) and lipase (50,750 U/L) were markedly elevated, favouring inflammatory pancreatic leakage over infectious peritonitis or biliary perforation. During PD, effluent enzyme concentrations and cell counts declined, acidosis resolved, and kidney function improved. The patient subsequently died of septic shock. Emerald-green peritoneal effluent is rare and warrants urgent evaluation for serious intra-abdominal pathology.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了重症胰腺炎患者接受急性腹膜透析时引流出翠绿色腹水，腹水淀粉酶和脂肪酶显著升高，提示为炎性胰腺渗漏而非感染或胆道穿孔，且透析期间酶浓度和细胞计数下降、酸中毒和肾功能改善。

items.title_cn: 学术中心外科医生实施的小儿ERCP：10年数据
items.title_en: Surgeon-performed pediatric ERCP at an academic center: 10-year data
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 目的 评估在学术医疗中心由外科医生实施的小儿内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）的疗效与安全性。方法 对2012年至2022年间在一家三级学术医疗中心实施的168例小儿ERCP手术进行回顾性分析。所有手术均由三名接受过专科培训、专攻软式内镜的普外科医生完成。结果 在10年期间，共对146例小儿患者实施了168例ERCP。平均年龄为13岁，最小患者为2个月大。最常见的适应证为胆总管结石，其次为原发性硬化性胆管炎、慢性或复发性胰腺炎，以及肝移植术后狭窄或漏。插管成功率为95.8%。总体并发症发生率为5.3%，30天内无与ERCP相关的死亡。结论 我们证明，在学术医疗中心由接受过专科培训的外科医生实施ERCP，在小儿人群中是一种安全且成功率高的手术。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Purpose To evaluate the outcomes and safety of pediatric endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) performed by surgeons at an academic center. Methods Retrospective review of 168 pediatric ERCP procedures performed at a tertiary academic center between 2012 and 2022. All procedures were performed by three fellowship-trained general surgeons specializing in flexible endoscopy. Results A total of 168 ERCPs were performed in 146 pediatric patients during the 10-year period. Mean age was 13 years, and the youngest patient was 2 months old. The most common indication was choledocholithiasis, followed by primary sclerosing cholangitis, chronic or recurrent pancreatitis, and stricture or leak after liver transplant. Successful cannulation was achieved in 95.8% of cases. The overall complication rate was 5.3%, with no ERCP-related mortality within 30 days. Conclusion We demonstrate that ERCP is a safe procedure in the pediatric population, with a high success rate, when performed by fellowship-trained surgeons at an academic center.
items.summary_cn: 该研究回顾了10年间外科医生在学术中心为146名儿童患者实施的168例ERCP，成功插管率为95.8%，总体并发症率为5.3%，无30天内ERCP相关死亡，表明由受过专科培训的外科医生操作儿童ERCP安全且成功率高。

items.title_cn: 儿童人群ERCP的安全性与有效性：三级医疗中心经验
items.title_en: Safety and Effectiveness of ERCP in the Pediatric Population: A Tertiary Care Center Experience
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：与成人相比，儿科内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）的研究仍明显不足，尤其是在婴儿中，主要受限于操作数量较少。本研究旨在评估某三级医疗中心18年间儿科ERCP的适应证、操作细节、技术成功率及不良事件，并特别关注体重低于10 kg的患者。方法：对2005年至2023年间在ISMETT接受ERCP的所有18岁以下患者进行回顾性分析。收集并报告人口统计学数据、适应证、操作细节、结局及不良事件。对首次ERCP操作进行亚组分析，并按体重和适应证类型进行分层。结果：共对84例患者实施了194次ERCP。急性或慢性胰腺炎是最常见的适应证。各体重组的技术成功率均较高。不良事件仅发生在体重≥10 kg的患者中（7%），主要为ERCP术后胰腺炎。体重<10 kg组未报告不良事件。在“首次ERCP”亚组中，胰腺适应证的不良事件发生率高于胆道适应证，但由于事件数量较少，该估计值不够精确。结论：作为专科中心的经验，儿科ERCP被证明是安全且有效的，即使在体重<10 kg的婴儿中也是如此。胰腺适应证似乎比胆道适应证具有更高的不良事件风险，尽管该估计值不够精确。
items.abstract_en: Background and Aim: Pediatric ERCP remains significantly less studied compared to its application in adults, particularly in infants, due to the limited procedural volume. This study aims to evaluate the indications, procedural specifics, technical success rates, and adverse events associated with pediatric ERCP at a tertiary care center over an 18-year period, with specific attention to patients weighing less than 10 kg. Methods: A retrospective analysis of all ERCPs performed on patients under 18 years of age at ISMETT between 2005 and 2023. Demographic data, indications, procedural specifics, outcomes, and adverse events were collected and reported. Subgroup analyses focusing on initial ERCP procedures were performed and stratified by weight and indication type. Results: 194 ERCPs were performed on 84 patients. Acute or chronic pancreatitis was the most common indication. Technical success was high across weight groups. Adverse events occurred only in patients ≥ 10 kg (7%), predominantly post-ERCP pancreatitis. No adverse events were reported in the <10 kg group. In the “first-ERCP” subgroup, pancreatic indications were associated with a higher adverse event rate than biliary indications, although the estimate was imprecise owing to the small number of events. Conclusions: In our experience as a specialized center, pediatric ERCPs have proven to be safe and effective, even in infants < 10 kg. Pancreatic indications appeared to carry a higher risk for adverse events than biliary indications, although this estimate was imprecise.
items.summary_cn: 该研究显示，在三级医疗中心，儿童ERCP（包括体重<10kg的婴儿）技术成功率较高，不良事件仅发生在≥10kg患者中（7%），主要为术后胰腺炎；胰腺适应症的不良事件率可能高于胆道适应症，但估计不精确。

items.title_cn: 胆石症患者良性胆道梗阻的预防及术后干预
items.title_en: PREVENTIVE AND POSTOPERATIVE INTERVENTIONS FOR BENIGN BILE DUCT OBSTRUCTION IN PATIENTS WITH GALLSTONE DISEASE
items.abstract_cn: 引言。复杂性胆石症在临床上仍具有重要影响，其中约25%的病例发生胆道梗阻。在寻找该病理最佳治疗策略方面持续的科学和技术进步，为提高这些患者的护理质量并缩短住院时间创造了机会。目的。本研究旨在从临床上论证联合微创手术治疗策略在胆石症患者良性胆总管梗阻预防与纠正中的应用价值。材料与方法。分析了2020年至2025年期间在市非营利企业“基辅市第一临床医院”收治的胆石症患者的治疗结果。研究纳入3，268例胆石症患者，其中912例（28%）为复杂型胆石症。所有患者均经临床证实存在胆总管结石。结果。对包括3，268例胆石症患者（其中912例为复杂性胆总管结石）的临床资料进行分析，揭示了根据所选治疗策略不同，在临床病程、术后并发症和住院时间方面存在若干关键差异。在接受腹腔镜胆囊切除术联合术中胆道镜检查的患者中（n = 150），仅9例（0.3%）因存在较大或多发结石而无法通过常规机械取石取出，需要行激光碎石术。在所有上述病例中，均在同一手术过程中通过重复胆道镜检查确认实现了胆总管的完全清除。该亚组中未记录到术中或早期术后并发症。在经乳头介入治疗组（n = 488）中，主要于急诊条件下实施，74例患者（14.9%）出现并发症。最常见的并发症为内镜逆行胰胆管造影术后胰腺炎，共64例（12.8%）；其中11例患者需要转入重症监护室。括约肌切开部位出血发生于7例患者（1.4%），十二指肠穿孔见于3例（0.6%），需中转开腹并紧急手术干预。结论。腹腔镜胆总管切开术联合胆道镜可视化及激光碎石术在治疗复杂性胆总管结石方面显示出较高的临床疗效，可确保胆道完全清除，术后并发症发生率低，并缩短住院时间。
items.abstract_en: Introduction. Complicated gallstone disease remains a clinically significant condition, with biliary obstruction occurring in approximately 25% of cases. Continuous scientific and technological progress in the search for optimal treatment strategies for this pathology creates opportunities to improve the quality of care for these patients and reduce the duration of hospital stay.Aim. The aim of the study was to clinically substantiate the strategy for using combined minimally invasive surgical treatment for the prevention and correction of benign common bile duct obstruction in patients with gallstone disease.Materials and methods. The results of treatment for gallstone disease were analysed at the Municipal Non-Profit Enterprise “Kyiv City Clinical Hospital No. 1” for the period from 2020 to 2025. The study included 3,268 patients with gallstone disease, including 912 patients, or 28%, with complicated forms of the disease. All patients had clinically confirmed choledocholithiasis.Results. Analysis of the clinical material, which included 3,268 patients with gallstone disease, of whom 912 had complicated forms of choledocholithiasis, revealed several key differences in the clinical course, postoperative complications and length of hospital stay depending on the selected treatment strategy.Among patients who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy with intraoperative choledochoscopy (n = 150), only 9 cases, or 0.3%, required laser lithotripsy due to the presence of large or multiple stones that could not be removed by conventional mechanical extraction. In all these cases, complete clearance of the common bile duct was achieved and confirmed by repeat choledochoscopy during the same surgical procedure. No intraoperative or early postoperative complications were recorded in this subgroup.In the group of transpapillary interventions (n = 488), which were performed predominantly on an emergency basis, complications were registered in 74 patients, or 14.9%. The most frequent complication was post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis, which occurred in 64 cases, or 12.8%; 11 of these patients required transfer to the intensive care unit. Bleeding from the sphincterotomy site occurred in 7 patients, or 1.4%, while duodenal perforation was observed in 3 cases, or 0.6%, requiring conversion and urgent surgical intervention.Conclusions. Laparoscopic choledochotomy combined with choledochoscopic visualisation and laser lithotripsy demonstrates high clinical efficacy in the treatment of complicated choledocholithiasis, ensuring complete clearance of the bile ducts with a low rate of postoperative complications and a reduced length of hospital stay.
items.summary_cn: 该研究比较了腹腔镜胆总管探查联合胆道镜激光碎石与经乳头介入治疗（如ERCP）在胆总管结石合并梗阻中的疗效，发现前者胆道清除率高且并发症少，但研究焦点为胆道梗阻而非胰腺炎或消化道早癌，仅与ERCP/内镜技术领域有间接关联。

items.title_cn: 肠道菌群来源的核黄素通过CD40-巨噬细胞通路介导MUC2对急性胰腺炎的保护作用
items.title_en: Gut microbiota-derived riboflavin mediates protective effects of MUC2 in acute pancreatitis via CD40-macrophage pathway
items.abstract_cn: 肠道屏障功能障碍在急性胰腺炎（AP）的发病机制中至关重要，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。黏蛋白2（MUC2）是肠道黏液层的主要成分，对肠道稳态和微生物共生至关重要。本研究旨在阐明肠道MUC2在AP中的保护机制。我们报道了AP患者肠道MUC2表达降低，且与疾病严重程度相关。肠道上皮特异性Muc2敲除（Muc2 ΔIEC）小鼠以肠道菌群依赖性方式表现出加重的AP。在AP诱导后，Muc2 ΔIEC小鼠中乳酸杆菌丰度降低，且核黄素水平相应下降。补充核黄素可有效改善Muc2 ΔIEC小鼠的AP，而给予核黄素合成缺陷的工程菌株则未能提供保护作用。MUC2缺乏加重了胰腺中巨噬细胞主导的免疫失衡，而核黄素可逆转这一现象。体外实验揭示，核黄素通过抑制CD40信号通路来抑制促炎性巨噬细胞活化。这种抑制保护了线粒体功能，并逆转了促炎基因启动子处的组蛋白H3乙酰化。我们的研究表明，肠道MUC2缺乏与微生物来源的核黄素水平降低相关，而核黄素可通过CD40通路部分抑制促炎性巨噬细胞活化。在AP中靶向微生物来源的核黄素可能有助于改善疾病进程。视频摘要
items.abstract_en: Gut barrier dysfunction is critical in the pathogenesis of acute pancreatitis (AP), yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Mucin 2 (MUC2), the primary component of the intestinal mucus layer, is essential for gut homeostasis and microbial eubiosis. This study aimed to elucidate the protective mechanism of intestinal MUC2 in AP. We reported that intestinal MUC2 expression was decreased in AP patients and correlated with disease severity. Intestinal epithelial-specific Muc2 knockout ( Muc2 ΔIEC ) mice demonstrated exacerbated AP in a gut microbiota-dependent manner. Decreased abundance of Lactobacillus and correlated reduced levels of riboflavin were found in Muc2 ΔIEC mice after AP induction. Supplementation with riboflavin effectively ameliorated AP in Muc2 ΔIEC mice, whereas administration of an engineered strain deficient in riboflavin synthesis failed to provide a protective effect. MUC2 deficiency aggravated a macrophage-dominant immune imbalance in the pancreas, which was reversed by riboflavin. In vitro experiments revealed that riboflavin suppresses pro-inflammatory macrophage activation by inhibiting the CD40 signaling pathway. This inhibition preserved mitochondrial function and reversed the histone H3 acetylation at pro-inflammatory gene promoters. Our study demonstrates that intestinal MUC2 deficiency is associated with reduced levels of microbiota-derived riboflavin, which could partially suppress pro-inflammatory macrophage activation via the CD40 pathway. Targeting the microbiota-derived riboflavin in AP may help to ameliorate the disease course. Video Abstract
items.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了肠道菌群来源的核黄素通过CD40-巨噬细胞通路介导MUC2对急性胰腺炎的保护作用，但摘要未提供具体实验发现或结论。

items.title_cn: 护士主导硬膜外镇痛期间因堵塞报警误判导致局麻药过量：病例报告及文献复习
items.title_en: Local anesthetic overdose during nurse-led epidural analgesia due to occlusion alarm misinterpretation: a case report and literature review
items.abstract_cn:
硬膜外镇痛（EA）用药错误在麻醉和疼痛管理中属于罕见但严重的不良事件。既往文献主要报道涉及药物类型或给药途径的错误，而由输注装置引起的错误较为少见。本病例强调了在使用注射泵进行EA单次推注时，异常“堵塞”报警可能导致剂量过量的潜在风险。

一名36岁男性，因复发性高脂血症性重症急性胰腺炎（第三次发作）收入重症监护病房（ICU）。入院时疼痛评分为7/10（视觉模拟评分法，VAS）。予以胸段硬膜外镇痛（T8-T9），采用局部麻醉药混合液持续输注并间断单次推注以缓解疼痛。

EA局部麻醉药过量导致广泛交感神经阻滞，表现为EA推注后急性低血压、心动过速及双下肢麻木。

鉴于患者第4天疼痛评分高达8/10，医嘱给予5 ml EA镇痛混合液单次推注。护士使用注射泵进行推注。由于导管阻力较高，注射泵反复触发“堵塞”报警。护士误判为药物未注入，在反复清除报警后继续操作，最终推注约10 ml。发现后立即关闭EA通路，快速静脉输注500 ml复方氯化钠溶液，并通过注射泵静脉给予去甲肾上腺素0.2 μg/kg/min。

血流动力学在10分钟内恢复，双下肢感觉在30分钟内逐渐恢复正常。事件发生5天后患者转至其他科室，无远期后遗症。

在护士主导的硬膜外单次推注过程中，对注射泵“堵塞”报警的误判可导致局部麻醉药过量。本病例强调需加强对设备特性及报警管理的培训。
items.abstract_en:
Epidural analgesia (EA) medication errors are rare but serious adverse events in anesthesia and pain management. Previous literature has predominantly reported errors involving drug types or routes of administration, whereas those caused by infusion devices are uncommon. This case highlights the potential hazard of dose overdose resulting from an abnormal “occlusion” alarm when using a syringe pump for EA bolus.
 
 
 
 A 36-year-old male with recurrent hyperlipidemic severe acute pancreatitis, third episode, was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU). On admission, the pain score was 7/10 (visual analog scale, VAS). Thoracic epidural analgesia (T8-T9) was administered, with continuous infusion and intermittent boluses of a local anesthetic mixture for pain relief.
 
 
 
 Extensive sympathetic blockade due to EA local anesthetic overdose, manifested as acute hypotension, tachycardia, and bilateral lower limb numbness after EA bolus administration.
 
 
 
 Given that the patient's pain score was as high as 8/10 on day 4, a 5 ml EA bolus of the analgesic mixture was prescribed. The nurse used a syringe pump for the bolus. Due to high catheter resistance, the pump repeatedly triggered an “occlusion” alarm. The nurse misinterpreted this as no drug infusion and continued the procedure after repeatedly clearing the alarm, ultimately administering approximately 10 ml. Upon recognition, the EA route was immediately closed, and rapid intravenous infusion of 500 ml of compound sodium chloride solution was administered, along with intravenous norepinephrine at 0.2 μg/kg/min via a syringe pump.
 
 
 
 Hemodynamics recovered within 10 min, and sensation in both lower limbs gradually returned to normal within 30 min. The patient was transferred to another department 5 days after the event, with no long-term sequelae.
 
 
 
 Misinterpretation of a syringe pump's “occlusion” alarm during nurse-led epidural bolus administration can lead to local anesthetic overdose. This case underscores the need for improved training on device characteristics and alarm management.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了硬膜外镇痛期间因注射泵'堵塞'报警误判导致局麻药过量，引发广泛交感神经阻滞，表现为低血压、心动过速和双下肢麻木，经及时处理后恢复。该病例与重症急性胰腺炎的疼痛管理相关，但核心关注点为麻醉镇痛设备使用安全，而非胰腺炎诊治本身。

items.title_cn: 胆管包虫病的范式转变：内镜治疗是否正从桥梁转变为确定性单一疗法？
items.title_en: Shifting Paradigms in Cholangiohydatidosis: Is Endotherapy Transforming from a Bridge to Definitive Monotherapy?
items.abstract_cn:
囊性棘球蚴病（CE）由细粒棘球绦虫的幼虫期引起，是一种全球范围内认识不足的人畜共患病。据估计，在任何特定时间约有100万人受其影响，在地中海地区、中东、中亚、中国西部、东非和南美洲的流行疫源地，发病率超过每10万人年50例。[1] 印度承担了其中相当一部分疾病负担。全国发病率估计为每10万人1至200例，安得拉邦和泰米尔纳德邦为典型的传统高发区。[2] 拉贾斯坦邦南部[3]和克什米尔谷地也持续存在长期公认的流行聚集区，后者一项基于人群的、超过1400份样本的大型血清学调查证实了传播仍在持续。[4] 近期来自印度北部的血清阳性率数据显示，临床疑似患者中抗细粒棘球绦虫IgG阳性率高达46%，提示传播活跃且可能正在加剧。[5] 与其他地区一样，肝脏在印度病例系列中仍是最常受累的器官。尽管疾病负担沉重，印度缺乏国家层面的CE监测框架，使得三级医疗中心的病例系列——如本期《消化内镜杂志》发表的来自北方邦的研究[6]——成为了解印度次大陆复杂性胆道穿透性疾病的主要信息来源。对于有症状或并发症的活动性囊肿，目前并存三种主要的治疗模式：苯并咪唑类化疗（阿苯达唑为首选药物，通常为10至15 mg/kg/d）、手术切除（范围从保守的囊肿切除术到正式的肝切除术），以及影像引导下经皮穿刺引流——最常见的是PAIR（穿刺、抽吸、注射杀头节剂、再抽吸）。这些方法均未直接针对疾病已突破胆道树的那部分患者。破入胆道系统是肝棘球蚴病自然病程中最常见的并发症，将慢性、通常无症状的占位性病变转变为急性外科和脓毒性急症。[7] 随着囊内压升高，被包裹在囊周组织中的胆管分支逐渐缺血。由此产生的破裂根据仅内囊破裂还是两层囊壁均破裂，被分类为包裹性破裂、交通性破裂或直接破裂。[8] 临床上，患者的表现从轻度肝酶异常到明显的胆管炎、胆绞痛、胰腺炎和危及生命的脓毒症不等，这正是所讨论病例系列中三位患者的临床表现。历史上，该并发症几乎是外科医生的专属领域，通过胆总管切开术、T管引流、胆总管十二指肠吻合术或肝管空肠吻合术处理，对于中央型或多房性病变常联合囊肿切除术或肝切除术。[9] 直到最近，内镜的角色仍被界定为辅助性的：作为确定性手术前解除胆管炎和清除胆管内碎屑的桥梁。Sahoo及其同事提出了另一种观点，主张内镜治疗不仅是临时措施，而可能是具有治愈潜力的单一疗法。该报告是一项回顾性、单中心病例系列研究，描述了在印度一家具有丰富肝胆内镜专业知识的三级转诊机构中，对三例经精心选择的、合并胆道内破裂和胆管炎的肝棘球蚴囊肿患者进行内镜治疗的情况。三例患者均为不良手术候选者——营养不良、脓毒症或存在需要行大范围或扩大肝切除术的中央型囊肿——因此接受了保守的分阶段内镜治疗。每位患者均接受了大致相似的治疗流程：内镜下括约肌切开术、胆管造影以确认囊胆交通部位、鼻囊胆管引流联合或不联合胆道支架置入、对脓毒症持续存在的感染性囊腔进行辅助经皮引流，以及同时给予阿苯达唑。通过系列超声检查、横断面影像学和胆管造影对结局进行追踪，中位随访时间为18个月。三例患者临床均有改善，末次随访时均已拔除支架且肝功能恢复正常。然而，临床病程既不短暂也无并发症。所需内镜操作次数为2至5次。三例患者均出现支架堵塞性胆管炎复发，其中首例患者复发两次。两例患者需要对感染性囊腔进行辅助经皮引流，一例患者的非交通性残余囊肿尽管经过长期药物治疗，最终仍需行腹腔镜囊周切除术。这是一个有意义的细微差别，摘要中“完全治愈”的表述可能低估了这一点：在成功的情况下，内镜单一疗法是一个持续数月之久、涉及多次操作的漫长过程，而非一次决定性的干预。本病例系列与作者自身回顾的关于破裂性肝棘球蚴病内镜治疗的更广泛文献基本一致，而非显著偏离。它进一步证实内镜单一疗法在经选择的患者中是可行的，但支架相关胆管炎和需要反复操作是常态而非例外。作者坦率地指出，缺乏程序标准化以及各中心专业水平参差不齐是推广该方法时受限的因素。还有几个额外的局限性值得强调。发表偏倚几乎肯定会影响这一文献体系，因为需要中转手术的内镜单一治疗失败病例不太可能作为专门系列被报道。随访时间虽然中位数为18个月尚属合理，但相对于胆管狭窄或晚期复发可能在多年时间框架内显现而言仍然较短。患者选择标准——即哪些囊肿适合内镜治愈、哪些必须切除——仍然是经验性的、隐含的，而非可重复的、经外部验证的预测指标。最后，费用、对患者的操作负担（多次住院、反复镇静、长期留置引流管）以及生活质量结局均未报告，然而这些对于与单次确定性手术进行任何客观比较都至关重要。对于临床医生而言，处理合并胆道破裂的肝棘球蚴病且患者存在脓毒症、营养不良或其他不适合手术的情况仍然具有挑战性。这种表现在流行地区、资源受限环境中尤为常见，本病例系列为保守治疗增加了合理的支持证据。在少数患者中，积极的内镜减压联合持续的鼻胆管或支架引流及苯并咪唑治疗，可以在经过审慎选择的病例中避免大范围肝切除，且一些以内镜引流作为“手术桥梁”启动治疗的患者，经过持续治疗可能完全不需要手术。择期切除不应在胆管炎缓解后即被反射性地安排。该领域将极大受益于以下进展：建立带有标准化WHO-IWGE囊肿分期的前瞻性多中心登记系统，以识别内镜治愈与失败的形态学和临床预测因素；明确规范引流管类型、支架留置时间和阿苯达唑方案的标准化方案，以减少中心间异质性；在匹配的手术风险分层中进行内镜单一疗法与PAIR及手术的直接比较研究，即使是非随机化的；以及系统性地报告以患者为中心的结局，包括住院次数和费用，同时报告解剖学治愈率。在这些数据积累之前，对于胆道内破裂的肝棘球蚴囊肿，内镜单一疗法最好被视为针对特定高危患者亚群的一种有价值的、有循证依据的选择，尚不能替代个体化的多学科决策——后者仍将手术作为可手术疾病的标准治疗。

items.abstract_en: Cystic echinococcosis (CE), caused by the larval stage of Echinococcus granulosus , is a globally under-recognized zoonosis. An estimated one million people are affected at any given time, with incidence exceeding 50 cases per 100,000 person-years in endemic pockets across the Mediterranean, the Middle East, Central Asia, western China, East Africa, and South America.[ 1 ] India carries a substantial share of this burden. National incidence estimates range from 1 to 200 per 100,000 population, with classical high-prevalence foci in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.[ 2 ] Long-recognized endemic clusters also persist in southern Rajasthan[ 3 ] and in the Kashmir Valley, where a large population-based serosurvey of over 1,400 samples confirmed ongoing transmission.[ 4 ] Recent seroprevalence data from North India report anti- E. granulosus IgG positivity as high as 46% among clinically suspected patients, suggesting active and possibly intensifying transmission.[ 5 ] As elsewhere, the liver remains the most commonly affected organ in Indian series. Despite this burden, India lacks a national CE surveillance framework, leaving tertiary-center case series, such as the one published in this issue of Journal of Digestive Endoscopy from Uttar Pradesh[ 6 ] as the principal source of insight into complicated, biliary-penetrating disease in the subcontinent. For symptomatic or complicated active cysts, three broad treatment modalities coexist: benzimidazole chemotherapy (albendazole being the agent of choice, typically 10 to 15 mg/kg/d), surgical resection, ranging from conservative cystectomy to formal hepatectomy, and image-guided percutaneous drainage – most commonly PAIR (puncture, aspiration, injection of a scolicidal agent, and re-aspiration). None of these modalities directly addresses the subset of patients whose disease has already breached the biliary tree. Rupture into the biliary system is the most common complication in the natural history of hepatic hydatid disease, transforming a chronic, often asymptomatic mass lesion into an acute surgical and septic emergency.[ 7 ] As intracystic pressure rises, biliary radicles entrapped within the pericyst become progressively ischemic. The resulting rupture has been classified as contained, communicating, or direct, depending on whether the endocyst alone or both cyst layers are breached.[ 8 ] Clinically, patients present along a spectrum ranging from mildly deranged liver enzymes to overt cholangitis, biliary colic, pancreatitis, and life-threatening sepsis, precisely the picture described in the three patients at the center of the case series under discussion. Historically, this complication has been the near-exclusive domain of the surgeon, managed by choledochotomy, T-tube drainage, choledochoduodenostomy, or hepaticojejunostomy, often combined with cystectomy or hepatic resection for centrally placed or multiloculated disease.[ 9 ] Endoscopy's role was, until recently, framed as adjunctive: a bridge to decompress cholangitis and clear ductal debris ahead of definitive surgery. Sahoo and colleagues present an alternate view, proposing endoscopic therapy not as a temporizing measure but as potentially curative monotherapy. The report is a retrospective, single-center case series describing endoscopic management in three carefully selected patients with hepatic hydatid cysts complicated by intrabiliary rupture and cholangitis, treated at a tertiary Indian referral institute with considerable expertise in hepatobiliary endoscopy. All three were poor surgical candidates – malnourished, septic, or harboring centrally located cysts that would have mandated major or extended hepatectomy – and were managed with conservative, staged endoscopic treatment instead. Each patient underwent a broadly similar algorithm: endoscopic sphincterotomy, cholangiography to confirm the site of cystobiliary communication, nasocystic biliary drainage with or without biliary stenting, adjunctive percutaneous drainage of the infected cyst cavity where sepsis persisted, and concurrent albendazole. Outcomes were tracked with serial ultrasonography, cross-sectional imaging, and cholangiography over a median follow-up of 18 months. All three patients improved clinically, becoming stent-free with normalized liver function at the last follow-up. The clinical course, however was neither brief nor free of complications. The number of endoscopic sessions required ranged from two to five. Stent-block cholangitis recurred in all three patients, twice in the index case. Two patients needed adjunctive percutaneous drainage of infected cyst cavities, and one patient's non-communicating residual cyst ultimately required laparoscopic pericystectomy despite prolonged medical therapy. This is a meaningful nuance that the abstract's “complete cure” framing risks understating: where successful, endoscopic monotherapy was a prolonged, multiprocedure undertaking spanning many months, not a single decisive intervention. The present series is broadly consistent with, rather than a marked departure from, the wider literature on the endoscopic management of ruptured hepatic hydatid disease that the authors themselves review. It reinforces that endoscopic monotherapy is feasible in selected patients, but that stent-related cholangitis and the need for repeated procedures are the norm rather than the exception. The authors candidly note the lack of procedural standardization and heterogeneity of expertise across centers as limiting factors in generalizing this approach. Several additional limitations merit emphasis. Publication bias almost certainly affects this body of literature, since failed endoscopic monotherapy requiring conversion to surgery is less likely to be reported as a dedicated series. The follow-up duration, while reasonable at a median of 18 months, remains short relative to the multiyear timeframes over which biliary strictures or late recurrence might manifest. The criteria for patient selection—that is, which cysts are amenable to endoscopic cure and which mandate resection—remain implicit and experience-based rather than reproducible, externally validated predictors. Finally, cost, procedural burden on the patient (multiple hospital admissions, repeated sedation, prolonged indwelling drains), and quality-of-life outcomes are not reported, yet these are central to any honest comparison with a single definitive surgical procedure. For clinicians managing hepatic hydatid disease with biliary rupture in septic, malnourished, or otherwise surgically unfit patients remains challenging. This presentation is disproportionately encountered in endemic, resource-constrained settings and this series adds legitimate weight to conservative management. In limited patients, aggressive endoscopic decompression, combined with sustained nasobiliary or stent drainage and benzimidazole therapy, can obviate major hepatic resection in carefully chosen cases, and some patients started on endoscopic drainage as a “bridge to surgery” may, with sustained therapy, not require surgery at all. Elective resection should not be reflexively scheduled the moment cholangitis resolves. The field would benefit substantially from the following developments: prospective multicenter registries with standardized WHO-IWGE cyst staging at baseline, to identify morphological and clinical predictors of endoscopic cure versus failure; explicit protocols specifying drain type, duration of stenting, and albendazole regimen to reduce inter-center heterogeneity; direct comparative studies, even if non-randomized, of endoscopic monotherapy versus PAIR and surgery in matched surgical-risk strata; and systematic reporting of patient-centered outcomes, including the number of hospitalizations and cost, alongside anatomical cure rates. Until such data accrue, endoscopic monotherapy for intrabiliary ruptured hepatic hydatid cysts is best regarded as a valuable, evidence-informed option for a defined subset of high-risk patients, not yet a substitute for individualized, multidisciplinary decision-making that continues to include surgery as the default for operable disease. items.summary_cn: 该病例系列报告了内镜治疗（括约肌切开术、鼻胆管引流/支架置入）联合药物治疗，在精心选择的、不适合手术的肝囊性包虫病合并胆道破裂患者中，可作为潜在的根治性单一疗法，但治疗过程漫长且常需多次内镜操作，并伴有支架堵塞性胆管炎等并发症。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
